thread:
maria_sales: Helios POC stuck on rerank step. They POST candidates and get 400 dims mismatch, sometimes 413 when they send big lists. Can we swarm? :eyes:
aj_engineer: Paste the exact error and a sample payload (sanitized).
maria_sales: From their log: ```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 768"
}
```
tess_ml: 1536 vs 768 = their embed model is half-size. Options: have them switch to our 1536 embed model, or use server-side embed for POC (we re-embed their raw docs).
aj_engineer: Also 413s indicate payload too big. Recommend chunking candidates to <=300 for rerank-large and using gzip.
maria_sales: They said their embed client is legacy and returns 768. They need a quick unblock for a demo in 24h.
aj_engineer: Fast unblock: enable server-side embedding for this org id and set max_candidates=256. Example cURL: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"raw_documents":["doc1","doc2"],"query":"q","rerank_model":"rerank-large","embed_on_server":true,"max_candidates":256}'
```
tess_ml: Tradeoffs: server-side embed adds latency and embedding token cost. For POC we can offer a credit; for longer term they should migrate to our embedding model or deploy Dedicated.
sam_security: Security: if they send PII to server-side embed, we need an NDA and the infosec questionnaire. For Dedicated we can discuss data residency and KMS. I'll send our SOC2 summary.
maria_sales: Can someone flip the flag for Helios and send me a short note I can forward to their ops?
ops_bot: Feature flag enabled: embed_on_server=true, max_candidates=256 for org-helios at 2027-10-11T15:40:02Z
aj_engineer: Sent a short test checklist to Helios: 1) try the cURL above; 2) if still seeing 413, gzip and chunk (python snippet: `for c in chunks(candidates,256): post(c)`); 3) run `print(len(get_embedding("a")))` to confirm dims if they later switch client.
maria_sales: Helios ran the server-side flow and it cleared the dims error. Latency went up ~110ms per 100 candidates. They're OK for demo but will evaluate migration. I'll open a POC credit request and start NDA thread. :thumbsup:
